note: Public interface contracts to compete against. Each entry is a generic, standards-grounded I/O contract and metric, NOT a Q2 implementation. Mission-specific physical devices (sensors, emitters) and integrated mission ICs are never listed here.

metric.ranking: information-entropy-normalized efficiency (see WITNESS.md); submit via the witness rail, design stays private (hash-only).

ieee754-fp32.notes: Correctly-rounded binary32 product. Handle signed zero, inf, NaN, subnormals per 754-2019.
Correctly-rounded binary32 sum. Accumulator variant chains s_next = round(acc + x).
The 754-2019 default rounding attribute applied to a wider intermediate.
754-2019 convertToInteger; signal/saturate on overflow and NaN per the chosen policy (state it).
754-2019 convertFromInt; round when |i| exceeds 24-bit exact range.
Exact on binary32; not a 754-defined op. Define NaN pass-through.
Exact: normalize an unpacked (sign, exponent, significand) triple to a rounded binary32 field. Building block.
binary32 approximation (e.g. Newton-Raphson). Publish the achieved ULP/relative-error bound as part of the contract.
binary32 approximation. Publish the achieved accuracy bound.
binary32 approximation. Publish the achieved accuracy bound.

ocp-mx.semantics: Decode one OCP MX FP4 (E2M1) element to its real value.
p = decode(a) * decode(b) for one element pair.
ocp-mx.notes: Per-element product ahead of block reduction. Scales applied at block level, not per lane.
OCP MX block of K=32 E2M1 elements with one shared E8M0 (8-bit power-of-two) scale each. Accumulate to binary32.

ocp-mx.ports: acc_out[31:0], a_blk, b_blk, a_scale, b_scale, acc_in[31:0]
ocp-mx.notes: One accumulating processing element: a block dot-product added to a running binary32 accumulator.
